sources.claim: DevDay Da Nang is a premier non-profit IT event, 11th edition in 2026, at Duy Tan University
DevDay 2026 attracted more than 3,000 participants
EAI INISCOM 2026 held Feb 26-27 at Duy Tan University, covering AI, 6G, Digital Twins, Quantum Computing
ICIIT 2026 (11th edition) held March 5-8 in Da Nang, co-organized by FPT University and Swinburne Vietnam
EAI RAIDS 2026 held March 10-12 at Dong A University in Da Nang, covering responsible AI and data privacy
DAVAS 2026 ran May 25-27, featuring 50 pitching startups, organized by Da Nang Department of Science and Technology
Web3 Builders' Summit LFBUIDL 2026 ran May 24-27 at Risemount Premier Resort, 350+ builders, free but curated entry
Unchained Summit Vietnam 2026 held May 28-29 at Furama Resort, 500+ delegates, covering Web3, crypto, and policy
Vietnam's State Securities Commission and Da Nang People's Committee participated in Unchained Summit
Super Vietnam 2026 scheduled for July 10-11 in Da Nang, focusing on blockchain, AI and Web3
Super Vietnam 2025 launched in Da Nang June 4-5 as a global tech conference on AI and blockchain
GDG Cloud Da Nang has 1,905 members and runs monthly Cafe Code meetups and annual DevFest
DevFest 2025 Cloud Da Nang held December 6, 2025 at Vanda Hotel, covering Google Cloud and Generative AI
GDG Mien Trung is a Google Developer Group serving Central Vietnam, based in Da Nang
Google I/O Extended MienTrung 2025 held July 12, 2025 in Da Nang with 500+ developers
Da Nang Software Park 2 ICT1 building opened January 2025
Da Nang launched a semiconductor Fab-Lab project July 2025 worth VND 1.8 trillion
Da Nang authorities adopted measures to develop hi-tech industry and IT alongside smart city and startup ecosystems
Super Vietnam 2025 aimed to connect global tech leaders and solidify Da Nang's position on the regional tech map
